from collections import Counter

# Fields: size | origin | item type | material | smell
raw = """
medium|Portuguese|bottle|steel|vanilla
large|Portuguese|wallet|glass|citrus fruits
extra-small|French|ruler|concrete|baking bread
large|German|bottle|glass|citrus fruits
small|German|car|plastic|chocolate
extra-extra-small|Spanish|calculator|steel|garlic
extra-large|Mexican|clock|concrete|vanilla
large|Iranian|speaker|glass|gasoline
extra-extra-large|Afghan|earring|steel|lavender
small|Iranian|wrench|steel|freshly cut grass
medium|French|candle|steel|garlic
small|Afghan|sofa|plastic|gasoline
extra-extra-small|Brazilian|clock|glass|leather
extra-large|Canadian|bed|steel|wet dog
extra-large|Spanish|stapler|steel|wet dog
extra-extra-large|Canadian|lamp|concrete|citrus fruits
extra-extra-large|Iranian|watch|steel|freshly cut grass
extra-large|British|pencil|glass|pine needles
extra-extra-large|Turkish|marker|steel|freshly cut grass
extra-small|Chinese|plier|glass|gasoline
medium|Mexican|ruler|steel|lavender
extra-extra-large|Afghan|saw|steel|garlic
large|French|watch|plastic|citrus fruits
extra-small|Brazilian|hammer|ceramic|coffee
large|Canadian|earring|plastic|popcorn
large|Italian|key|ceramic|coffee
extra-small|Canadian|plier|concrete|lavender
extra-large|Russian|bottle|glass|wet dog
large|Turkish|earring|plastic|lavender
extra-small|Polish|canvas|glass|gasoline
extra-extra-small|Iranian|watch|ceramic|citrus fruits
extra-extra-small|Brazilian|umbrella|plastic|garlic
extra-large|British|calculator|plastic|coconut
extra-large|Japanese|key|concrete|garlic
large|Afghan|lamp|concrete|popcorn
extra-extra-small|Afghan|candle|glass|freshly cut grass
extra-extra-small|Turkish|trash can|plastic|rose
small|Iranian|screwdriver|ceramic|coffee
"""
runs = [
    ("black", 2), ("blue", 4), ("brown", 2), ("cyan", 1),
    ("gold", 3), ("gray", 1), ("green", 3), ("indigo", 2),
    ("ivory", 1), ("khaki", 2), ("maroon", 1), ("orange", 1),
    ("pink", 2), ("purple", 1), ("red", 4), ("silver", 3),
    ("turquoise", 2), ("white", 1), ("yellow", 2),
]
colors = [color for color, count in runs for _ in range(count)]
rows = [line.split("|") for line in raw.strip().splitlines()]
assert len(rows) == len(colors) == 38

initial = [
    dict(zip(("size", "origin", "name", "material", "smell", "color"),
             fields + [color]))
    for fields, color in zip(rows, colors)
]

after_sister_counts = Counter({
    "black": 2, "blue": 3, "brown": 2, "cyan": 1, "gold": 2,
    "gray": 1, "green": 3, "indigo": 2, "ivory": 9, "khaki": 2,
    "maroon": 1, "pink": 1, "purple": 1, "red": 3, "silver": 1,
    "turquoise": 2, "white": 1, "yellow": 1,
})
after_dad_counts = after_sister_counts.copy()
del after_dad_counts["pink"]

original_pairs = {(x["smell"], x["color"]) for x in initial}

def qualifies(x):
    return (
        x["color"] == "silver"
        or x["size"] == "extra-extra-large"
        or x["material"] == "ceramic"
        or x["smell"] == "wet dog"
        or x["origin"] == "Turkish"
    )

# Every possible favorite color must occur in the reported color counts:
# there are plastic items, and none has yet been removed.
possible_totals = set()
histories = []
for favorite in after_sister_counts:
    changed = []
    for item in initial:
        item = item.copy()
        if item["material"] == "plastic":
            item["color"] = favorite
            item["smell"] = "vanilla"
        changed.append(item)
    if Counter(x["color"] for x in changed) != after_sister_counts:
        continue

    # A color absent from the collection cannot explain the changed counts.
    for removed_color in after_sister_counts:
        remaining = [x for x in changed if x["color"] != removed_color]
        if Counter(x["color"] for x in remaining) != after_dad_counts:
            continue

        after_teacher = [
            x for x in remaining
            if not (x["color"].startswith("b") or len(x["name"]) == 6)
        ]

        type_counts = Counter(x["name"] for x in after_teacher)
        after_even_rule = [
            x for x in after_teacher if type_counts[x["name"]] % 2 == 1
        ]

        # Add one copy of each qualifying existing item, using the fixed
        # set of (smell, color) pairs from the initial collection.
        before_loss = after_even_rule + [
            x.copy() for x in after_even_rule
            if (x["smell"], x["color"]) not in original_pairs
        ]

        before_count = sum(map(qualifies, before_loss))
        loss_indices = [
            i for i, x in enumerate(before_loss)
            if x["size"] == "extra-extra-large"
        ]
        for i in loss_indices:
            final_collection = before_loss[:i] + before_loss[i + 1:]
            possible_totals.add(sum(map(qualifies, final_collection)))

        histories.append({
            "sister_color": favorite,
            "dad_removed_color": removed_color,
            "after_teacher": len(after_teacher),
            "after_even_rule": len(after_even_rule),
            "before_loss": len(before_loss),
            "qualifying_before_loss": before_count,
            "possible_lost_items": len(loss_indices),
        })

print("Consistent histories:", histories)
print("Possible final counts (exhaustive):", sorted(possible_totals))
if not possible_totals:
    print("UNSUPPORTED: no consistent completed history")
    print("CHECK UNKNOWN")
elif len(possible_totals) == 1:
    print("Expected answer:", next(iter(possible_totals)))
    print("Submitted answer: unknown")
    print("CHECK FAIL")
else:
    print("Expected answer: unknown")
    print("CHECK PASS")
